sn12.37:1.2: Nāyam bhikkhave kāyo tumhākam na pi aññesaṃ || 3
sn12.37:1.3: Purāṇam idam bhikkhave kammam abhisaṅkhatam abhisañcetayitam vedaniyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4
sn12.37:2.1: Tatra kho bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasi karoti || || 5
sn12.37:2.2: Iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti || imassuppādā idam uppajjati ||
sn12.37:2.3: imasmin asati idam na hoti || imassa nirodhā idam nirujjhati || Yad idam
sn12.37:2.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti ||
sn12.37:2.9: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || pe|| ||
